title: About IBU and Study Programs
text:
International Burch University (IBU) is located in Ilidža, Sarajevo. Its institutional description presents an entrepreneurial university model that emphasises innovation, recognising opportunities, transferable skills and an entrepreneurial mindset. Its mission includes lifelong learning, education and research within a critical and creative learning environment. The university also identifies engagement with the community as part of that mission.

The official website lists three faculties: the Faculty of Engineering, Natural and Medical Sciences, the Faculty of Economics and Social Sciences, and the Faculty of Education and Humanities. This structure brings together technical, natural science, medical, social science and humanities fields of education. The institutional description also identifies a digital element in the curriculum, supported by information and communication technologies in teaching and by classroom technology.

Programmes in the undergraduate admissions overview include Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Genetics and Bioengineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering and Dentistry. Management, International Relations and European Studies, and Economics and Finance are also listed. The overview further includes Graphic Design and Multimedia, Digital Communications and Public Relations, and Film and Video Production. Each listed entry links to more detailed information about the programme.

The admissions portal presents undergraduate, master's and doctoral study separately. Programme names are accompanied by BA, MA and PhD labels for the levels shown. Information Technology and Management, for example, are listed with labels for all three levels. Graphic Design and Multimedia is shown with BA and MA labels. The overview therefore allows prospective students to check the listed level of education alongside the subject area.

IBU's educational approach emphasises independent thinking, creativity and problem solving. It connects academic development with integrity, empathy, resilience and respect for others. The university's vision describes continuous mentoring and academic and personal guidance as supporting education, research and development, innovation and entrepreneurship. These are the institution's stated educational aims.

The admissions page directs prospective students towards information about admission procedures, student exchanges, financial resources, student life and scholarships. It contains separate links for financial aid and scholarships, and for tuition and fees. These resources complement the overview of programmes and study levels with practical information relevant to considering study at the university.
